# llms.txt – AI Guidance for src/Common Utilities

## Folder Purpose

- Contains core utilities (mStd, mMaybe, mSpan, mTextStream, mParserGen, etc.)
- Shared functionality for the entire SPO_CS project

## Coding Standards

- Use C# 13 features with modern syntax
- Tabs for indentation (4 spaces)
- Keep lines under 120 characters
- Use collection expressions [ ... ]

## File Structure

- Each utility should have:
  1. Interface/abstract class definition
  2. Implementation class
  3. Test file (ending with .Tests.cs)

## Error Handling

- Use mError.Error for runtime errors
- Use mAssert for test assertions
- Include detailed error messages

## Performance Notes

- Avoid unnecessary allocations
- Prefer immutable data structures
- Use Span<T> for buffer operations

## Testing

- All utilities must have 100% test coverage
- Use mTest framework for test registration
- Include both unit and integration tests

## Modules

Dependencies must be declared with `// IMPORT` at the top of each module.

Whenever new imports are introduced, update the module table to keep it current.

- mStd – Core standard library utilities and foundational types
- mMaybe – Optional value handling and monadic operations
- mSpan – Memory-safe buffer operations with tSpan<t>
- mTextStream – Text processing and streaming utilities
- mParserGen – Parser generation and pattern-matching utilities

See [_MODULES.md](_MODULES.md) for the full table of modules and their dependencies.
